synthesis.body: A shipped-instruction check keyed on a fixed N-line window around a statement is satisfiable by adding lines rather than by fixing the defect. Two explanatory comment lines pushed a statement's governing transition out of a six-line window, turning a flagging check green while the property went unverified. Key such a check on an enclosing structural boundary such as a fenced block, and assert a non-vacuity floor naming how many sites must have been examined.

title: A check keyed on a fixed line window is satisfiable by adding lines, not by fixing the defect
